entities.name: Louis Désiré Blanquart-Evrard
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Louis Désiré Blanquart-Evrard was a French inventor, photographer and photo publisher. Being a cloth merchant by trade, in the 1840s he developed interest in photography and focused on technical and economical issues of mass production of photo prints.
